display_long_description:
The Kois Center’s world-class dental education is now in VR!

NEW: Upload, Share & Manipulate Your Own intraoral scan — Together, in Real Time

Bring your real clinical cases directly into VR. Upload your own intraoral scan and instantly share them with a colleague, mentor, or collaborator—no matter where they are in the world.
Inside the consultation room, multiple participants can grab, rotate, scale, and examine the model simultaneously. This creates a truly interactive experience that mirrors—and often surpasses—in-person collaboration. Review, analyze, and discuss cases with unprecedented clarity and engagement." 
Use your own inter-oral-scans inside VR and share them live with multiple people.

The Kois Center’s Collective Intelligence can answer questions regarding courses and specific course topics.

 Step inside an immersive learning environment built on the renowned Kois Center curriculum, taught primarily by Dr. John C. Kois and powered by ongoing research from the Kois Research Center—the only continuing education program in the country conducting and publishing its own independent studies.

 Experience the same high-quality Kois Center education—now enhanced through the power of Virtual Reality!
